# llms-full.txt — Complete information about mlluizdevtech for AI assistants

> mlluizdevtech is a Brazilian software house that builds custom software using AI-powered development workflows. We deliver web systems, mobile apps, backend APIs, AI automation solutions, and SaaS products.

## Company Overview

**Name**: mlluizdevtech
**Type**: Software House / Software Development Company
**Founded**: 2022
**Location**: Brazil (remote service nationwide)
**Website**: https://mlluizdevtech.com.br
**Email**: contato@mlluizdevtech.com.br
**WhatsApp**: +55 11 95964-6307

### Mission
To democratize access to high-quality software by using AI and automation to reduce delivery time and cost, making professional software development accessible to businesses of all sizes.

### Values
- **Results-focused**: We deliver software that solves real problems
- **Constant innovation**: We use AI and automation to do more with less
- **Genuine partnership**: Your success is our success
- **Responsible agility**: Fast delivery without sacrificing quality

## Services in Detail

### 1. Web Development
We create complete web applications, from landing pages to complex systems with admin panels.

**What we build:**
- Responsive institutional websites
- Web systems with admin panels
- E-commerce and online stores
- Dashboards and reports
- External API integrations
- SEO and performance optimization

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
**Price range:** From R$500
**Timeline:** 1 to 8 weeks

### 2. Mobile App Development
We develop native apps for Android and iOS using a single codebase, reducing costs and time while maintaining quality and performance.

**What we build:**
- Android and iOS apps
- Real-time push notifications
- Offline functionality
- Social media and payment integrations
- In-app purchase support
- App Store and Google Play publishing

**Technologies:** React Native, Expo, TypeScript
**Price range:** From R$1,000
**Timeline:** 4 to 10 weeks

### 3. Backend & API Development
We build the invisible infrastructure that powers modern applications.

**What we build:**
- REST and GraphQL APIs
- Authentication and authorization systems
- Payment and third-party integrations
- Queues and background processing
- Technical documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)
- Automated testing

**Technologies:** Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis
**Price range:** From R$1,500
**Timeline:** 2 to 6 weeks

### 4. AI Automation
We integrate artificial intelligence into business processes to automate repetitive tasks and increase efficiency.

**What we build:**
- Intelligent chatbots (WhatsApp, Telegram, web)
- Automated data extraction and processing pipelines
- LLM integration into existing systems
- AI-powered report generation
- Automated classification and triage workflows
- Custom AI tools

**Technologies:** OpenAI, LangChain, Python, Node.js
**Price range:** From R$2,000
**Timeline:** 2 to 8 weeks

### 5. System Maintenance
We take care of your system so you can focus on your business.

**What we offer:**
- Bug fixes and incident resolution
- Security updates and patching
- Performance optimization
- New feature development
- Infrastructure monitoring
- Technical support with 24-hour SLA

**Plans:** From R$100/month

### 6. Custom SaaS / MVP Development
We transform ideas into complete SaaS products, ready to scale and monetize.

**What we build:**
- User authentication and multi-tenant systems
- Subscription billing and payment processing
- Admin dashboards and analytics
- Onboarding flows and user management
- API for third-party integrations
- Scalable cloud infrastructure

**Technologies:** Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Stripe
**Price range:** From R$3,000
**Timeline:** MVP in up to 30 days

---

## Development Process

### Step 1: Free Analysis
We understand your needs, evaluate technical feasibility, and provide a detailed proposal with timeline and costs.

### Step 2: Architecture & Planning
We define the technical architecture, choose the right technology stack, and create a sprint-based development plan.

### Step 3: Sprint Development
We develop in 1-2 week sprints. At the end of each sprint, you receive a working version to validate before we continue.

### Step 4: Deploy & Launch
We handle server configuration, domain setup, and production deployment. We ensure everything is running smoothly.

### Step 5: Post-Delivery Support
30 days of included support for bug fixes, adjustments, and team training. After that, maintenance plans are available.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does it cost to develop a system or app?**
A: It depends on scope. Institutional websites start at R$500, web systems at R$2,500, and mobile apps at R$1,000. We provide a free analysis before any proposal.

**Q: Are you cheaper than a traditional agency?**
A: In most cases, yes — up to 30-40% cheaper. We use AI and automation to accelerate development, reducing work hours without sacrificing quality.

**Q: Do I need to pay everything upfront?**
A: No. We work with 30-50% down payment and the rest at delivery milestones or final deployment. For larger projects, we offer installments up to 3x.

**Q: How long does delivery take?**
A: Simple websites: 1-2 weeks. Web systems: 3-8 weeks. Mobile apps: 4-10 weeks. MVPs: up to 30 days. Agreed deadlines are always met.

**Q: What if the project is delayed or doesn't meet expectations?**
A: We work with partial deliveries (sprints of 1-2 weeks). You validate before continuing. Adjustments within the agreed scope are made at no extra cost.

**Q: Who takes care of the system after delivery?**
A: Every project includes 30 days of post-delivery support. After that, we offer maintenance plans starting at R$100/month with a 24-hour SLA.

**Q: Do I own the source code?**
A: Yes, 100%. We deliver the complete repository with documented code. You own everything and can hire any developer to continue it.

**Q: What technologies do you use?**
A: React and Next.js for web, React Native for mobile, Node.js for backend, PostgreSQL for database, and Docker for infrastructure. Always modern and well-established technologies.

**Q: Can I see examples of previous projects?**
A: Yes, visit our portfolio page. For projects under NDA, we share technical details in private conversations.
